entities.summary: Tevita Momoedonu (b. 1946-01-13, Lautoka) was a explorer or navigator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Lautoka and Fiji. Known in the fields of fiji, political leaders, oceania.
